name: jtbd-job-mapper
description: JTBD Job Mapper by Uladzislau Dziarkach — two Claude Code skills that turn customer research into a Jobs-to-be-Done package (Advanced JTBD + Next Move Theory, Ivan Zamesin), rendered either as a FigJam board or a self-contained HTML file.

plugins.name: jtbd-job-mapper
